text.body: śrīḥ śrīśārīrakādhīkaraṇaratnamālā saprakāśā prathamādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ prakāśaḥ śrīstananyastakastūrīnistulāmodameduram | vistārayatu me svasti vastu kaustubhalakṣaṇam || nāthayāmunayatīśatādṛśāmnāyamauligururatnagumphitā | bhātu me guruparamparāmayī hārayaṣṭiranaghā hmadantare| kauśikadeśikasūriśśasanataḥ śrīnivāsasya | adhikaraṇaratnamālāṃ nirmāya vyākarotyenām || sa bhagavānbādarāyaṇaḥ paramakāruṇiko mumukṣujanānujighṛkṣayā paravidyāsu mumukṣubhirbhajanīyatayā śrutaṃ devatāviśeṣaṃ tattadvidyāvicāreṇa nirdidhārayiṣustadvicārarūpaṃ śārīrakaśāstraṃ prāṇaiṣīt | tasyaitasya śāstrasyārvācīnaivyākhyātṛbhiḥ kaluṣitatayā śāstrāvatārāya prayojanālābhamālocatayā bhagavatā bhāṣyakṛtā yathāvasthitaśāstrakṛdabhiprāyavivaraṇena tasya saprayojanatāṃ saṃpipādayiṣatā viracitasya vitatagambhīraśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyasyārthasaṃgraharūpaṃ anvahamātmanaḥ paradevatābhajanā''vṛttikṛte śārīrakādhikaraṇa ratnamālākhyaṃ granthamārambhamāṇo granthakṛt ādau cikīrṣitasya granthasya nirvighnaparisamāptaye śārīrakaśāstra nirdhāritaparadevatābhajanarūpaṃ maṅgalamācarati | atra śrīśeṣaśailaśṛṅge ujjvalamityanenāvatāraviśeṣasya pratipādanāt tasya ca svasamāśrayaṇīyatvārthatvāt viśeṣataśca tasya hastavinyāsaviśeṣeṇa svacaraṇasya samāśrayaṇīyatāvyañajakatvāccopāyatvenāvasthānaṃ sūcitam| phaṇīndrasyotsaṅge ujjvalitamityanena "vaikuṇṭhe tu pare loke śrīsahāyo janārdanaḥ | mahāyogī jagaddhātā divyasiṃhāsanopari | divyasaṃstaraṇopete śeṣāhiphaṇamaṇḍite" ityādyuktaprakriyayā nityavābhūtāvanantasyoparyāsikāviśeṣo vivakṣitaḥ | tena ca tatra muktabhogyatayā'vasthānaṃ jñāpitam| itthaṃ cānena viśeṇadvayena līlāvibhūtāvupāyatayā nityavibhūtāvupeyatayā cāvasthānasya pradarśanena śārīrakaśāstre sādhanaphalādhyāyayornirdhāritaṃ śrīnivāsasya bhagavata upāyatvanupeyatvañacātra sūcitam | nigamottamāṅga ujjvalaṃ ityanena tatrobhayatra pramāṇaṃ pradarśitam | subālopanāṣadādyupaniṣatsu hi " mātā pitā bhrātā nivāsaśsaraṇaṃ suhmatgatirnārāyaṇa" ityādinā śrīnivāsasyopāyatvamupeyatvamubhayamāmnātam; tatra śaraṇa mityanenopāyatvasya 'gati'rityanenopeyatvasya cābhidhānāt | atha karmavicārānantaraṃ,ataḥ karmaṇo vicāritatvāt, brāhṛ jijñāsecchā viṣayībhūto brāhṛvācāraḥ kartavya iti śeṣaḥ || etadarthavivaraṇāya pravṛttamidaṃ padyam arthaḥ karmavicāraṃ kṛtavadbhiḥ karmaphaleṣvāśānāvṛttermokṣapuruṣārthaṃ apekṣamaiṇaiḥ puruṣairyatjijñaisyaṃ tacrchīnivāsākhyaṃ brāhṛ bhaje | bhāvaḥ adhītavedasya puṃso jaiminīkṛtakarmamīmāṃsoktanyāyaijryotiṣṭomādikarmaṇāṃ svarūpamīdṛśaṃ, taditthaṃ kartavyaṃ, svargādirūpaṃ tphalamitthaṃbhūtamiti niścaye sati, svargādiphalānāṃ naśvaratvajñānāttatprāptīcchā nivartate | bhṛprāptirūpamokṣapurūṣārthe āpātapratītisatvāttatprāptīcchā jāyate | evaṃ brahṛprāptīcchotpattau brāhṛsvarūpamīdṛśaṃ tatprāpatyupāyaścāyaṃ tatprāptirūpaphalaṃ cetthaṃbhūtamityevamādinirṇayahetubhūtaibrrāhṛmīmāṃsoktanyāyairyannirṇetavyaṃ tacchrīnivāsākhyaṃ brāhṛ nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃpādaparicaraṇapradakṣiṇapraṇāmādibhirārādhayāmāti || adhikaraṇapūrvapakṣaḥ karmamīmāṃsāyāmarthavādādhikaraṇe "āmnāyasya kriyārthatvādānarthakyamatadarthānāṃ tasmādanityamucyate," "vidhinātvekavākyatvāt stutyarthena vādhīnāṃ syuḥ" ityanayossūtrayoḥ,vedasāmānyasya yatkiñcitkartavyārthabodhakatvaniyamāt kartavyārthāvabodhakānāṃ arthavādarūpavedavākyānāṃ prāmāṇyāsaṃbhavādvedasāmānyasya na prāmāṇyaniyama iti prathamasūtreṇa pūrnapakṣaṃ kṛtvā arthavādavākyānāṃ yatkiñcitkartavyataya arthabodhakatvābhāve'pi sannihitavādhivākyavihita kriyānvayiprāśastyabodhakatayā vidhivākyena samamekavākyatayā prāmāṇyamupapadyata evetyanantarasūtreṇa jaimininā siddhāntitam || yujyate caitat | bālānāṃ prathamaṃ vṛddhavyavahāreṇa śaktigraho bhavati | tadyathā vyutpannena kenacidvyutpannamanyaṃ prati 'gāmānaye'tyukte, niyuktaḥ puruṣo gāmānayati | punarapi 'gāṃ naye'tyukte'nyatra nayati | pāśrvastho bālaḥ tadvākyaprayogāntaraṃ gavānayanaṃ gornayanaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā niyuktapuruṣasya gavānayanakartavyatājñānaṃ 'gāmānaye'ti vākyajanyaṃ, gornayanakartavyatājñānaṃ ca 'gāṃ naye'tyanantaravākyajanyamiti niścinvan, gopadaṃ ānayanarūpakriyādvayā nvayyarthaṃbodhakatvādgorvācakaṃ, ānayapadaṃ ānayanakriyāvācakaṃ, nayapadaṃ nayanarūpakriyāvācīti tattatpadānāṃ śakiṃta gṛhṇāti| evaṃ vṛddhavyavahmatavākyāntareṣvapi teṣāṃ teṣāṃ padānāṃ teṣu teṣvartheṣu śakiṃta jānāti | evaṃ vyavahārādeva śaktigrahe jāyamāne sarvaseyaiva vyavahārasya kāryārthaparatvadarśanāt sarvāṇi padāni yatkiñcit kartavyārthaparāṇīti niścinoti | ato vyutpatyanusāreṇa sarvāṇyapi padāni kāryārthaparāṇyeva | evaṃ laukika padānāṃ kāryaparatve siddhe 'ya eva laukikāssa eva vaidikā' iti nyāyena vaudikānyapi padāni kāryaparāṇyeva iti kriyānātmake brāhṛṇi vedāntavākyānāṃ tātparyābhāvāt vedāntavicārarūpa brāhṛvicāraśāstraṃ na ārambhaṇīyamiti | siddhāntaḥ bālānāṃ prathamavyutpattiḥ vṛddhavyavahārādeva bhavatīti idaṃ tāvat sarvānubhavaviruddham| prathamavyutpatteḥ anyathaivānubhavasiddhatvāt| tadyathā mātāpitrādayaḥ svaśiśūn vyutpādayitukāmāḥ candragavādikaṃ pitrumātulādikaṃ ca vastupradaśrya muhurmuhuḥ aṅgulyānirdeśapūrvakam "ayaṃ candraḥ" "iyaṃ gauḥ", "ayaṃ pitā" "ayaṃ mātulaḥ"ityādi śabdān prayuñjate| śiśuśca purovartivastupradarśanāṅgulinirdeśatattacchabdaprayogāṇāṃ niyamena sāhacaryadarśanarūpeṇa udbodhakena pūrvajanmānubhūtāṃ evaṃvidhaceṣṭāyāṃ tattatpadānāṃ tattadarthānāṃ ca sambandhajñāpanārthatāṃ smarati | tataśca candrādipadānāṃ purovṛtticandrādyarthānāṃ ca kaścitsambandho'stīti sāmānyato jānan bahubhiḥ purūṣaistattadartheṣu tatprayogaṃ śṛṇvan tayoḥ padapadārthayoḥ sambandhāntarāsambhavaṃ ca jānan 'idaṃ padametadarthabodhakaṃ ' iti tayoḥ bodhyabhodhakabhāvarūpasambandhaviśeṣaṃ niścinoti | evaṃ kāryānanvita evārthe prathamataḥ padānāṃ śaktigrahaṇadarśanāt prathamato vṛddhavyavahārāt kāryānvita evārthe śaktigraha ityupapannam | kāryaparādvākyādeva śaktigrahaḥ ityapyanupapannam; 'caitra putraste jātaḥ 'ityādiṣu siddhārthaparādvākyādapi śaktigrahadarśanāt | tatra hi caitrasya putrotpattijñāpanāya niyuktena kenaciccaitraṃ prati 'caitra putraste jāta' iti vākye prayukte, avyutpannaḥ kaścidanyaścaitragṛhe caitrasya putrotpatiṃta tannivedanāya puruṣasya niyuktatāṃ tadvākyaśravaṇena caitrasya mukhavikāsaṃ ca paśyan, caitraṃ prati taduccaritavākyasya caitraṃ prati putrotpattirūpārthabodhakatāṃ niścinoti | ataḥ kāryaparādeva vākyāt śaktigraha iti na niyamaḥ | tadevaṃ kvacitsiddhaparavākyāt kāryānanvite, kvacit kāryaparavākyātkārye ca yathāyathaṃ śaktigrahaṇāt prābhākarāṇāṃ sarvaṃpadānāṃ kāryārthaparatvavarṇanaṃ niryuktikamiti | ato vedāntavākyānāṃ siddharupe brāhṛṇi tātparyasaṃbhavāt tadvicāraśāstramārambhaṇīyamiti || evaṃvidhapūrvapakṣatparihāraparatvamasya sūtrasya kāryānanvayino brāhṛrūpasiddhavastuno vicāraviṣayatva pradarśanādeva niścīyate| vedāntavākyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kāryaparatve hi siddharūpasya brāhṛṇo vedāntavākyairvicāryatvavarṇanaṃ anupapannaṃ syāt | tarhi pūrvodāhmatajāminyuktivirodhaḥ syāditi ceducyate pūrvapakṣyuktaṃ sarveṣāṃ vedavākyānāṃ kāryaparatvamabhyupagamya parihmataṃ jaimininā, na tu tasya tathaivābhiprāya iti dvayorna virodhaḥ | asmin śloke 'viracitakarvicārai 'riti puruṣaviśeṣeṇa karmavicārānantarameva brāhṛvicārasya kartavyatālābhāt brāhṛvicāraṃ prati karmavicārasya niyamena pūrvavṛttatvaṃ labhyate | tat kuta iti ceducyate adhītavedasya puruṣasya vedavākyeṣu karmaphalasya brāhṛjñānaphalasya ca kvacitsthiratve kvacidasthiratve āpātataḥ pratipanne sati anayoḥ kiṃ tātvikamiti nirṇayecchā jāyate | tathā ca tannirṇākaśāstreṣu pravartamānasya puruṣasya karmaphaleṣu tannirṇayaupāyika śāstravicāra eva prathamaṃ pravṛttirjāyate;karmaṇāṃ anādivāsanayā sukaratvaniścayādanabhyastasya brāhṛjñānasya duṣkaratva niścayācca laghūpāyenābhimatārthasiddhisaṃbhave gurūpāye pravṛttyayogena karmaphaleṣu tannirṇayecchābrāhṛjñānaphale tannirṇayaupayikavicāre pravṛtteḥ pratibandhāt | karmavicāre kṛte karmaphalānāṃ asthiratvaniścayo bhavati | tadyathā "dākṣāyaṇayajñena yajeta" iti karmakāṇḍe darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe śrūyate | tatra dākṣāyaṇanāmā kaścidyajñaḥ kiṃ vidhīyate athavā darśapūrṇamāsayoreeva kaśacidguṇo vidhīyata iti saṃśaye jaimininā maharṣiṇā "vikāro vā prakaraṇāt " iti sūtreṇa darśapūṇarmāsayoḥ svargādiphalabhūyastvāyā''vṛttiḥ kartavyā iti śrutyarthaḥ iti nirṇītam | anena darśapūrṇamāsādikarmaṇāṃ phalabhūtaṃ svargādi naśvaramiti niścayo jāyate | darśapūrṇamāsādi sādhyasvargādiphalasya nityatve hi tasya cirakālanuvṛtyarthaṃ darśapūrṇamāsāvṛttividhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | evaṃ karmaphalānāṃ anityatvaniścaye karmavicārecchārūpapratibandhakanivṛttau brāhṛvicārecchādhīnā tadvicāre pravṛttirutpadyata iti brāhṛvicārasya niyamena karmavicārasāpekṣatvam || astvetat; sūtrābhiprāyavivaraṇāya pravatte'sminpadye sautrapadāspṛṣṭasya brāhṛṇaḥ śrīnivāsa nāmakatvoktiḥ kathamupapadyata iti ceducyate | asminbrāhṛmīmāṃsāśāstre brāhṛṇo jijñāsyatvaṃ pratijñāya jagajjnmādikāraṇatvaṃ tasya lakṣaṇamabhidhāya lakṣye lakṣaṇasamanvayāya taditareṣu tasya vyāvartanāya ca pravṛtteṣu īkṣatyadhikaraṇaprabhṛtiṣvadhikaraṇeṣu puruṣasūktanārāyaṇānuvākasubālopaniṣadādiṣu prasiddhaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ mahāpuruṣaṃ tadasādhāraṇadharmaviśeṣeḥ pratyabhijñāpya tatra lakṣaṇasamanvayasya taditareṣu vyāvṛttatāyāśca pradarśitatvena sa eva brāhṛpadārthatvena sūtrakārābhimata itīhāpi prathamasūtre brāhṛpadena sa eva vivakṣita iti na tasya sautrapadāspṛṣṭamiti | tadetaduttaratra spaṣṭīkariṣyati iti sarvaṃ niravadyam || iti jijñāsādhikaraṇam || 1 ||
